desc: Explore approaches and derive the batch-label/inversion model.
Implement RLE + constant-state DP solver and validate on public samples.
Brute-force verify the DP on all small equality patterns and random stress cases.
Validate structural lemmas: runs atomic, only last two batch labels matter, and only singleton-over-singleton backward merges are useful.
Finalize efficient Python code for T up to 1e5 and total N up to 2e5.
